title: Record the failed forward-example PPO comparison
summary: We completed both equal PPO budgets and the eight scheduled policy evaluations. Both arms fail each forward screen; the final example policy moves at 0.000961 m/s and the scratch policy at 0.004811 m/s for a 0.05 m/s command. We establish no benefit from this action-imitation initialization in the paired seed. We retain early physical terminations and the guard-interrupted allocation, and verify its fresh retry. We publish both final forward videos and selected checkpoints; full original recordings and raw captures remain on Spark and the workstation with hash inventories. We record ground force and motor torque without changing behavior gates. Stage 2 remains incomplete.
next: Review the failed initialization and forward-learning result before defining another experiment. Keep Stage 2 open and retain the Spark reservation.
